Center is q^(m+2); a quotient vector of least u-valuation j has partner annihilator count q^(m+2j), giving centralizer q^(2m+2+2j) and multiplicity q^(m+2)(q^(3(m−j))−q^(3(m−j−1))). Summation gives probability q^(−3m)+(1+q^(−1)+q^(−2))q^(−2m)(1−q^(−m)). Radical quotient is k×k versus F_(q²), proving nonisomorphism. For p=2m+1 prime, Cayley t=(r−1)/(r+1) has t^p=0 and s t s=−t, giving dihedral group algebra presentation. Independent full F3, m=1 direct multiplication/commutator matrices gave 729 elements per square class with dimensions {6:27,4:702} and 76545 commuting ordered pairs. Covers every odd q,m≥1; no char2 assertion.
